prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Discover Your Desktop Companion Journey", "Scroll through pet personalities and choose how your new desktop companion will interact with your daily workspace.", "Begin Setup"]
1: ["Sign In to Preserve & Restore Desktop Pets", "Log in to link your new companion and safely pull existing pets into your desktop collection.", "Your existing pet data will be merged seamlessly into your account."]
2: ["Save your newly adopted pet certificate to your cloud account."]
3: ["Ensure clear lighting and a single focused subject for optimal 3D pet rendering."]
4: ["Continue to Persona Setup"]
5: ["Preparing Desktop Rendering Workspace", "Checking screen overlay access and graphics engine status for smooth spawning.", "Validating desktop overlay graphics..."]
6: ["Building 3D Mesh Models", "Configuring Desktop Interactions"]
7: ["We will alert you on desktop as soon as your pet spawns."]
8: ["Mastering Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Use these simple shortcuts to interact with, hide, or command your pet anytime.", "Double Click: Talk to Pet | Right Click: Hide to Tray | Drag: Move Pet"]
9: ["Achievement: Desktop Explorer"]
